article.story: BATON ROUGE, La. -- — Saliou Niang and Donovan Dent both had double-doubles and LSU defeated Texas Southern 92-51 on Friday night. Niang had 15 points and grabbed 11 rebounds, and Dent paired 10 points with 10 assists. Abdi Bashir Jr. scored 15 points and the Tigers (2-0) had six players score in double digits. Texas Southern took an early lead and LSU didn't move out front until a 13-0 run made it 20-11 about eight minutes in. Late in the half, LSU had a 10-0 run that featured eight made free throws. LSU led 47-28 at halftime. LSU shot 56.7% in the first half and 57.6% in the second half for 57.1% overall. Texas Southern shot 23.7% for the game and made more free throws (16) than field goals (14). Jason Kimbrough Jr. led Texas Southern (0-2) with 16 points. LSU assistant coach Johnny Jones served as the head coach at Texas Southern for the past eight seasons before returning to Baton Rouge. Jones, a former player and head coach (2012-2017) at LSU, took the Houston-based Tigers to three NCAA Tournaments and five post-season appearances overall in his tenure at Texas Southern. Up next LSU: vs. Louisiana Tech on Monday.
